tactics:
intro α f g i j l; induction j generalizing l with
  | zero => simp [List.modifyTailIdx]
  | succ j ih => cases l <;> simp [List.modifyTailIdx, ← Nat.add_assoc, ih]

intro α f g i j; induction j with
  | zero => intro l; rfl
  | succ j ih => intro l; cases l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a l => simp [List.modifyTailIdx, ih]
intro α f g i j l
intro α f g i j
intro α f g i j l; induction l generalizing j <;> cases j <;> simp_all [List.modifyTailIdx]
